q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: WITH max_drinker AS (SELECT f.drinker, f.bar, f.times_a_week FROM frequents AS f JOIN (SELECT bar, MAX(times_a_week) AS mt FROM frequents GROUP BY bar) AS md ON f.bar = md.bar AND f.times_a_week = md.mt) SELECT f.bar, COUNT(f.drinker), AVG(s.price), md.drinker FROM frequents AS f JOIN serves AS s ON f.bar = s.bar JOIN max_drinker AS md ON f.bar = md.bar GROUP BY f.bar, md.drinker, md.times_a_week
